subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on June 15th, 2022. Your departure time is scheduled for 10:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please ensure you arrive at least 2 hours before departure for check-in and security procedures. If you have any special requests or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We hope you have a pleasant journey with us! Best regards, The Airline Team
